reviews.title: You can stick to this workout!
reviews.text:
If you questioning, if this works, yes! If you’re questioning, can I stick with it,yes! Are you going to lose 20 pounds and two weeks, no. Are you slowly going to get stronger with each exercise and want more, yes! I thought this was some gimmick on Facebook reels. I’ve tried just about every exercise and diet. You can think of. And this is the only one I’ve been able to stick with. And it doesn’t make you feel bad for taking a rest day. Ideally you wanna do it every day because it’s literally only 10 minutes. Who doesn’t have 10 minutes a day. I do it every day before I go to work and I feel ready to attack my day because this warmed my entire body up. This has also helped me with a right shoulder injury. The slow and steady movements and focusing on core strength and proper mechanics has helped me get some range of motion back in my right shoulder also. 
If you’re on the fence, definitely try it. I’ve even informed my Doctor. I’m doing it and he’s impressed with right shoulder healing progression.

reviews.title: App needs work
reviews.text: We found that the exercises were helpful for balance and posture and to get everything loosened up. It’s a great 28 day program. Just don’t try to have a program after that 28 days. The whole program just starts over again. Also, I wanted my program to change to intermediate instead of beginner and there’s not an option to do so. No need to buy a 90 day subscription. Sucks because I had hopes for this app and referred my friends to use it.
